svg.text: A free 8x8 instrument. It never changes what the sequencer shows.
Chromatic layout: rows stacked in fourths (+5 semitones per row). Purple = root, blue = in the chosen scale.
Scale mode (settings page) re-maps the pads to scale degrees only - no wrong notes. Octave UP/DOWN on the left.
Plays on its own MIDI channel, velocity-sensitive, poly aftertouch while pressed (tap NOTE to toggle).
Shown: root C, natural minor. Shift+NOTE opens the settings page; capture records from here when armed.
